༄༅/ /gzungs gzhug 'bul ba dang rab gnas bya tshul mdor bsdus 'khyer bde zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzungs gzhug 'bul ba dang rab gnas bya tshul

mdor bsdus 'khyer bde zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo badzra dhā ra ye/ 'dir rten la gzungs gzhug 'bul ba dang*/ rab gnas byed tshul tshang la mdor bsdus zhig brjod na/ gnyis las/ dang po ni/ srog shing tsandan dang shug pa sogs byung nas bcad pa'i gong nas phyogs mi nor ba'i mtshan ma btab pa mchod rten gyi chos 'khor yan chad dmigs bsal zlum po dang*/ gzhan gru bzhi pa/ rtsa ba nas rtse'i bar rim gyis phra sbom yod pa'i rtse mor rnam rgyal mchod rten brko ba'am bri/ de ma grub na bhruṃ 'bri srol yang 'dug cing*/ rtsa bar rdo rje phyed pa brko ba 'am bri ba gang ba de/ ring thung ni/ sku gzugs la skyil krung ngam lte ba yan chad dang*/ mchod rten la gdung chen yan gyi chad du bya/ yi ge bris pa'i mdog dang mi zlos pa'i dri tshon gyis byug / gnas lnga'i thad du rim par/ oṃ āḥhūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ zhes dang*/ sku'i dbu dbyings dang mchod rten gyi bre thad tsam la/ oṃ sarba bidya swā hā dang*/ mkhrin pa'i thad du dbyangs dang gsal byed/ thugs ka'i thad du/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā dang*/ lha gang yin gyi sngags la spel tshig sbyang ba/ lte ba'i shar ngos la rnam rgyal/ lhor dri med/ nub tu gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang du byang chub rgyan 'bum gyi gzugs ring thung gnyis ka'am gang 'grub/ bzhi ka'i gsham du rten 'brel snying po dang*/ de bod skad du bsgyur ba dang gnyis ka'ang gang rung dang*/ bzod pa dka' thub sogs thams cad dam gang thub/ gsang gnas kyi thad du oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā zhes pa rnams bri/ gzungs shog rnams dras te 'thud dgos pa rnams 'thud la dri bzang pos byug ste dbu nas nang du dam por gril/ dbu zhabs mi nor ba dang gzungs gang yin gyi rtags bya/ bgegs bskrad rab gnas ni/ gzungs bsgril ma bsgril grub zin pa'i skabs gsum ga'am/ ma grub na snga phyi gnyis kyi tshe bya zhing*/

gnod sbyin 'khor lo 'bri bsgrub sogs 'dod na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /'bul ba'i tshe/ srog shing*/ gzungs/ byin rten/ dri/ sman/ 'bru/ rin po che/ dar sogs yo byad gang dgos nam sta gon byas la/ dbang bskur rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs gang la'ang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i bsnyen pa sngon du ma song na mi rung bar bshad pas/ de sngon du song ba'i 'gul ba pos/ rten rnams bgegs bskrad rab gnas byas te/ oṃ mantā dhā tu gandhā wa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad ci rigs 'don cing 'bul/ rten gzhug pa'i rim pa la/ bla ma dam pa'i ring bsrel khyad par can dbu skra dang na za'i tshal bu ci rigs dang*/ khyad par de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung yod na sku gzugs kyi dbu'i gtsug dang*/ mchod rten gyi tog dang gdugs kyi nang du gzhug/nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzungs mdzod spu'i thad/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan sngags dang gdugs dkar gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur gyi gzungs rnams nor bu rgyas pa'i 'og dang mchod rten gyi brel na/ dbyangs gsal sogs gsung mtshon pa'i rigs rnams sku'i mgul dang mchod rten gyi zhabs/ bla med kyi gzungs dang thugs rdo rje mtshon pa'i rigs rnams sku'i stod dang mchod rten gyi bum stod/ rnal 'byor rgyud spyod rgyud bya rgyud kyi gzungs rnams go rim bzhin du sku'i sked dang bum sked/ gzungs chen sde lnga dang yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa dang mdo gzungs rnams sku'i lte 'og dang mchod rten gyi bum smad du 'jug cing*/ srog shing yod na de la 'ching*/ stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs rnams lan bza' dang mtshams dang ser po legs par btang*/ glegs bam 'jug tshe bden rang rang gi gzungs kyi tha dad dang*/ mi bden bla med sogs go rim ma log par sku'i skyil krung dang mchod rten gyi bang rim nang du gzhug cing*/

shog gu'i bar bar du dri bzang gi phye ma gdab/ dbu shog yar log pa'i yi ge dbu rten gyi rgyab ngos su 'ong bar bya nag gril gos dang gang 'byor dang phyi gril dar ser po byas te gzhug /sku'i rigs bden rang gi gzungs kyi thad du gzhug dgos na'ang bris thang yin na glo nas gril te dbu zhabs ma log par 'jug /de dag gis ma khengs pa'i bar rnams su dri bzang sna tshogs kyi phye ma 'thum por byas te 'gengs/ sku'i pad gdan gyi stod dang mchod rten gyi khri'i stod du dbus su bkra shis g.yas su chos skyong*/ g.yon du dpal mgon/ rgyab tu nor lha phyogs skyong rgyal chen sogs kyi sngags sam yang na go rim bzhin du bris pa gzhug /de dag gi bar du bra'o sogs rdzas ngan gyi rigs ma yin pa'i 'bru rigs rnams dar ras ser pos btums nas bcug ste mtshams dar btang*/ seng khri'i nang gi 'og tu zhabs bkag 'khor lo/ /de'i steng du bum gter/ de'i steng du tshogs bdag dang gnod sbyin 'khor lo rnams yod na dbu rten gyi rgyab ngos su 'ong bar byas te rim par 'jog cing*/ bum gter 'khor lo'i steng du 'jog pa'i lugs kyang yod pas gang bde/ dmigs pas la tshe ldan nam tshe 'das gang gi don du yin na/ de dang de'i khyad kyis gzungs dang spel tshig sbyor tshul shes par bya de yang sdig sbyong gtso bo yin na/ kun rig dang mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs sogs gang mang 'jug dgos pa'i rig 'gros sbyor/ de dag ni rgyal dbang lnga pa'i gsung dang lcang skya zhabs kyi bzhed pa bzhin bsdus nas bkod pa yin la/ de yang sku 'dra che ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /sku chung ba'i rigs yin na/ bla gzungs sogs thams cad dam/ gang mos logs su bkar te 'jug la/ steng 'og tu ma chud tshe dbus dang g.yas g.yon sogs kyis bskor ba byas kyang rung*/ gzhan 'jug ma bde na'ang rnal rgyal gtsug tor dri med gsang ba ring bsrel byang chub rgyan 'bum rten 'brel snying po ste gzungs chen sde lngar grags pa ni/

rgyud nas rten gyi nang du 'jug par gsungs pa'i gzungs khyad par can yin pas/ thams cad dam gang rigs 'jug pa gnad che/ gzhung nas ring bsrel dang na bza' dbu skra rnams rten gyi gtsug gi nang du 'jog pa bshad kyang*/ der ma nges te/ rten chung ba'i gtsug tu 'jog ma bde na/ de'i thugs ka man chad du gzhug rung zhing phyag len kyang yod pas so/ /de nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rigs rnams kyang go rim spyir gong du brjod pa ltar yin na'ang*/ ma bde ba'i tshe skabs bstun gyi bzhag tu rung ste/ dngos po'i gnas tshod la ni/ de rnams la che chung gi khyad par mtha' gcig tu dbye dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rab gnas ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang nas/ bdag bskyed rgyas pa'am/ yang na rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed nas bzhengs par gyur/ nang mchod yod na byin brlab bya zhing*/ bum pa rdzas mgul 'ching dang ldan pa bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du rdzas rnams rten gyi dri ma thams cad sbyong ba'i nus pa can du byung*/ hrīḥṣtiḥdang gzungs ci rigs bzlas nas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rten gsum ka yod na/ sku rten rnams hrīḥṣtiḥs bsangs swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mar 'khyud pa/ gzungs dang gsung rab rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas padma hrīḥmatshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis padma dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo la 'khyud pa/ mchod rten nas sātstsha gtsug lag khang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las 'khor lo bhruṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum spyan ma la 'khyud pa/

gsum ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rten gsum ka med tshe gang rung zhig bskyed na ni gsum ka'ang zhes la 'dor ro/ /lungs kar la drag sngags btab pa sta gon byas la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rten rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs bskrad par gyur/ oṃ sum bha ni brjod cing yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug pa sogs bya/ rgyas par na khro bo spyan 'dren cing*/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa dang*/ bden brjod kyang bya'o/ /de nas ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /sogs kyis rten la khrus gsol rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun nas/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas mtshan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis spyan drangs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā arghaṃ pra tītstsha nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku las pā ri wa ra arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā nas shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ spyan dbye mtshams 'dir byas kyang rung yang*/ 'og tu byed na/ mchod pa hrīḥṣtīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog / bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyo yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas sparsha āḥhūṃ/ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa'am/ bsdu na sngar ltar sngags tsam gyis 'dod yon lnga dang bcas pas mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dang*/ rdo rje dpag med sogs dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad sogs gsum ka'am/ gang babs dang phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod la/ 'dod na nang mchod kyang 'bul/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis khyed kyi ni/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsam/ /oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi shodha ne swā hā/ lan gsum/ ye shes kyi mig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas sems can gyi don la gzigs pa lhur mdzad par gyur/ ces brjod/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥdang lha gang yin pa'i sngags sam/ oṃ hūṃḥzhis brjod cing*/ rten la dngos su reg pa'am reg par mos te/ rdo rje 'chang yab yum zhu ba las sku brnyan gyi rnam par gyur/ 'od dpag med yab yum zhu ba las gsung rab dang gzungs sngags kyi rnam par gyur/ rnam snang yab yum zhu ba las mchod rten nam gtsug lag khang gi rnam par gyur/ zhes pa gsum ka'am gang rung skabs dang bstun/ de nas ye dharmā lan bdun nam gsum brjod la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du/ rgyal ba rnams brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu'ang rten 'di la spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten 'di ji srid 'byung ba me chu rlung gsum gyi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ shis brjod rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun la bya'o/ /smras pa/ sngon byon tshad ldan mkhas grub kyi/ /man ngag lag len mdor bsdus te/ / 'khyer bder bkod pa'i rnam dkar dges/ /thub bstan yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang dam pa snga ma'i man ngag las 'byung ba'i don bzhin gzhan la phan srid snyam pa'i 'dun pas shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/sarba maṅgalaṃ bha wantu/ bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/gzungs gzhug 'bul ba dang rab gnas bya tshul mdor bsdus 'khyer bde zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 322--PAGE 323--PAGE 316-
